parameters.subject: ={{ $json.subject }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO notifications_log (notification_type, channel, recipient, subject, message, payload, status, triggered_by_workflow, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.notification_type }}',
  '{{ $json.channel }}',
  {{ $('✅ Notification Validator').item.json.recipient ? "'" + $('✅ Notification Validator').item.json.recipient + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.subject.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.message.replace(/'/g, "''").substr(0,2000) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.results).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.overall_status }}',
  '{{ $json.triggered_by }}',
  NOW()
);

meta.description: Notification & Alert Engine - multi-channel: Telegram, Email (SMTP), Firebase FCM Push, External Webhook
